purpose: analysis-only linear closed-loop noise model; no loop is run; no scientific claim by itself
configuration: ci derivation of scripts/detector_level_convergence_study.py (eso_scao_smoke_5m_software@2 geometry with det_emccd_12m_medium_derived@3 physics), m_AB 9, DIAGNOSTIC reconstructor alpha 0.1
mask_rule: the reconstructor is probed with exactly the rows that carry noise valid (one fixed mask per rule for L, the injection and Sigma); the primary rule takes the operator the loop used in the plurality of analysed frames; the series' all-valid propagation weights are kept for the first draft's scalar value

noise_covariance.source: flat_wavefront_model (detector_covariance_v2 at a flat wavefront; a-priori)

feedback_spectrum.definition: eigenvalues of L = R_mask M on the controlled actuators (1 = unit feedback; below 1 = damped mode; the scalar model assumes all 1)
feedback_spectrum.unsensed_modes_note: a mode with feedback below 1e-6 is left unsensed by this mask; with no leak it has a unit pole, no stationary limit exists and the window prediction grows with the run length (the run is support-sensitive)

prediction.units: m2 (piston-removed pupil mean square of the noise-driven correction difference; the sidecar's delta_v_m2 in expectation)
prediction.primary: delta_v_exact_window_m2 (transient from identical initial commands with the noise entering after the latency, averaged over the analysed frames; noise covariance rule 'flat')
